_about: The story floor's rows (scripts/post-pack/story_floor.py; the story engine v5 plan, commit 3). The floor is the only reader of Krish's recorded rejections and returns pass or refused with the reasons, never a number, and never reorders (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-26: taste is a floor only). It reads: his refusals and the vetoes that stand (idea_checks.refusals_from, refused_findings, active_vetoes), the beat's avoid list (idea_checks.off_beat), the kill list and config/rejected-lines.json on the words we would put in front of a reader, the rejection-floor standards listed in standards below (through scripts/floor.py), the formats and bank rows he marked not for us (config/style-references.json), and the free divergent repeat guard (score with obvious given and no judge: zero model calls). A check that cannot run is listed as unread: never a pass. story_score.py never imports this file or its module.
note_codes_why: A soft refusal warns and never refuses until he approves P6 (idea_checks.P6_APPROVED); his own tick outranks an older refusal (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-12). Neither is a floor.
own_words_why: The kill list and the rejected lines read only the words we would put in front of a reader (idea_checks.option_words); a source's own headline in the gather pool is not ours and is not checked.

standards._about: Rejection-floor standards that can be read on an idea before it is made, each by a pattern. Only the story_angle and predictions_framing themes are read here; a standard must exist in config/rejection-floor.json and be approved or reworded, or the row is listed unread. The other standards in those themes govern how a finished piece is written (close, confidence, caveats) and are held at production, not here.

rows.reason: frames a new AI tool with doomsaying

repeat_guard.problem: Story ideas for makeyourmindup, a publication on AI in the creative, arts, music, entertainment, media and sports industries, for the week of {week}
repeat_guard.own_spark_why: an engine wildcard's own spark is in the archive by design (divergent.score)
